records.jp: ほぇ～、これが打ち上げ花火の大筒かぁ。<CR>なんだかロマン感じる！
records.en_original: Wooow, so these are the launchers for the fireworks? So cool!
records.en: Wooow, so these are the launchers for<CR>the fireworks? So cool!

records.jp: もしかしてお祭り好き？
records.en_original: Are you a fan of festivals?
records.en: Are you a fan of festivals?

records.jp: うん、好きだよ！<CR>みんな笑顔になれるじゃん！
records.en_original: Yeah, I love them! It's great seeing everyone having such a good time.
records.en: Yeah, I love them! It's great<CR>seeing everyone having such a good time.

records.jp: ん～、そう言う陽桜莉さんもいい笑顔だ
records.en_original: You look like you're having fun just talking about it.
records.en: Hmm, Hiori-san, you have a nice smile too.

records.jp: えへへ
records.en_original: Hehehe!
records.en: Hehehe!

records.jp: どんなの打ち上げてみたい？
records.en_original: What kind of fireworks do you think would be good?
records.en: What kind of fireworks do you think would be good?

records.jp: そうだなぁ……やっぱりお花柄の花火かな！
records.en_original: Let's see... I think flower shapes!
records.en: Let's see... I think flower shapes!

records.jp: 学校の花壇みたいに、<CR>夜空をお花畑にできたら……
records.en_original: I want the sky to look like our garden!
records.en: I want the sky to<CR>look like our garden!

records.jp: ん～、ロマンチックじゃないの！<CR>今度火薬玉から作っちゃおう！
records.en_original: Ooh, romantic! I'll get on making the fireworks!
records.en: Ooh, romantic! I'll get on<CR>making the fireworks!

records.jp: うん！　えへへ
records.en_original: Sounds good! Hehehe.
records.en: Sounds good! Hehehe.

records.jp: よし、準備おっけー！　じゃあ屋上に上がろっか！
records.en_original: Okay, all ready! Let's go up to the roof!
records.en: Okay, all ready! Let's go up to the roof!

records.jp: わぁ～～！
records.en_original: Wooow!
records.en: Wooow!

records.jp: 打ち上げ花火って綺麗だし、迫力もあるし、<CR>なんていうか――
records.en_original: Fireworks are just so big and beautiful...
records.en: Fireworks are just so big and<CR>beautiful...

records.jp: すっごい特別感がある！
records.en_original: They just feel special!
records.en: They just feel special!

records.jp: 特別感？
records.en_original: Special?
records.en: Special?

records.jp: うん。なんかもう、花火を見ながらだったら<CR>何を言っても特別な言葉に聞こえるんじゃないかな
records.en_original: Yeah. It's like, I could say absolutely anything during fireworks and it would feel extra special.
records.en: Yeah. It's like, I could say absolutely anything<CR>during fireworks and it would feel extra special.

records.jp: そ、それは言い過ぎなんじゃ――
records.en_original: I-I don't know if I'd go that far...
records.en: I-I don't know if I'd go that far...

records.jp: ――愛央ちゃん……私、ね……
records.en_original: Ao, I...
records.en: Ao-chan, I...

records.jp: う、うん……
records.en_original: Y-yes...?
records.en: Y-yes...?

records.jp: コーンをパンとかコロッケに入れるの……<CR>許せないんだ……
records.en_original: I hate pineapple on pizza...
records.en: Putting corn in bread or croquettes...<CR>I just can't forgive that...

records.jp: ……私も
records.en_original: ...Me too.
records.en: ...Me too.

records.jp: す、すごい！！　思わず同意しちゃったよ！！
records.en_original: W-wow! I agreed with you before I knew it!
records.en: W-wow! I agreed with you before I knew it!

records.jp: これが花火の力だよ！<CR>ほら愛央ちゃんも何か言ってみて！
records.en_original: That's the power of fireworks! You try saying something too!
records.en: That's the power of fireworks!<CR>Come on, Ao-chan, you say something too!

records.jp: 私ね……小さい頃、<CR>よくお風呂で技名を叫ぶ練習をしてたんだ……
records.en_original: When I was little, I used to pretend I had super powers while I was in the bath.
records.en: When I was little,<CR>I often practiced shouting move names in the bath...

records.jp: ――実は今もやってる
records.en_original: I still do, but I used to too...
records.en: —Actually, I still do it now.

records.jp: ……頑張り屋さん、だね
records.en_original: Practice makes perfect...
records.en: Practice makes perfect...

records.jp: ふとんが……
records.en_original: What time should you go to the dentist?
records.en: The futon...

records.jp: ――ふっとんだ
records.en_original: ...Tooth hurty.
records.en: —flew on.

records.jp: 深い
records.en_original: That's deep.
records.en: That's deep.

records.jp: は、花火の力凄い！<CR>普段だったら絶対変な空気になるのに！
records.en_original: Fireworks are amazing! Usually when I say that stuff it gets super awkward!
records.en: Fireworks are amazing!<CR>Usually when I say that stuff it gets super awkward!

records.jp: 変な空気どころか、すっごいエモーショナルだった！
records.en_original: It felt like you were saying something super emotional!
records.en: It felt like you were saying something super emotional!

records.jp: じゃ、じゃあさ……<CR>もし普通に特別な言葉を言ったらどうなるんだろ……？
records.en_original: Th-then what would happen if I actually did say something emotional?
records.en: Th-then what would<CR>happen if I actually did say something emotional?

records.jp: 特別な言葉って、日頃の感謝とか……こ、告白とか？
records.en_original: Like thanking someone for everything they do, or...a c-confession?
records.en: Like thanking someone for everything they do, or...a c-confession?

records.jp: あ、あのね私……
陽桜莉さんの誰にでも優しいところとか、<CR>一緒に馬鹿やって笑ってくれるところとか……
records.en_original: You're so nice to everyone, and you always joke around and laugh with me...
records.en: Things like how you're kind to everyone, Hiori-san,<CR>and how you fool around and laugh with me...

records.jp: そういうのがすごい暖かくていいなって思ってて、<CR>えっと、だからそのいつもありがとうっていうのと――
records.en_original: It really makes me happy. I just want to say thank you. And that I...
records.en: It really makes me happy. I just<CR>want to say thank you. And that I...

records.jp: だ、大好きだよ、っていうのを今お伝えしております
records.en_original: L-love you. I just wanted you to know that.
records.en: L-love you. I just wanted you to know that.

records.jp: ……ありがとう。私も愛央ちゃんのこと、大好きだよ
records.en_original: ...Thank you. I love you too, Ao.
records.en: ...Thank you. I love you too, Ao-chan.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん、ちょっと何か言ってみて
records.en_original: You say something, Hiori.
records.en: You say something, Hiori-san.

records.jp: う、うん……えっと
records.en_original: O-okay, um...
records.en: O-okay, um...

records.jp: こんな不思議な世界で、リーダーをやってくれて
records.en_original: Thank you for being our leader when everything is so crazy.
records.en: Thank you for being our leader when everything is so crazy.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんだって怖いことも、不安なこともあるのに<CR>みんなを引っ張っていってくれる
records.en_original: I know that you get scared just like the rest of us, but you still make sure to push us forward.
records.en: Even though you get scared and anxious too, Ao-chan,<CR>you still lead everyone forward.

records.jp: それってかっこいいなぁってすごく思うよ。<CR>今ぎゅってしてる愛央ちゃんはこんなに可愛いのに
records.en_original: I think you're really cool. And super cute to boot.
records.en: I think that's really cool—even though you're<CR>so cute when I'm hugging you like this, Ao-chan.

records.jp: うぅ……
大好きだよ、愛央ちゃん。いつもありがとう
records.en_original: I love you, Ao. Thank you for everything.
records.en: I love you, Ao-chan. Thank you for everything.

records.jp: 陽桜莉……さん……
records.en_original: Hiori...
records.en: Hiori...

records.jp: あ、あぶない！！
records.en_original: Th-that was close!
records.en: Th-that was close!

records.jp: はぁ、はぁ、はぁ……
records.en_original: *Pant* *pant*...
records.en: *Pant* *pant*...

records.jp: 花火って危険だね……
records.en_original: Fireworks are pretty dangerous, huh?
records.en: Fireworks are dangerous...

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
